details.exp1d: Combat Technique: YSTF Battle Formation A task team of three shall work as one, fight as one, and fall as one.
details.exp2d: Constitution: Honed to a Razor If a hundred attempts fail, then make a thousand tries. A true blade must be hammered and forged ten thousand times.
details.hb1d: Nature: Sculpture of the Land The natural arrangements of rolling mountains and meandering rivers mean something ... and the same goes for the people that live within.
details.hb2d: Charity: Every Taste of Life Once seen, it cannot be ignored. Once experienced, it will exert its touch. The most important part in the journey of life is knowing how to give and share its every taste.
